title: NeoTriFuse: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Fusion under Missingness Heterogeneity for Neonatal Mortality Risk Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.26436v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neonatal mortality risk prediction from bedside monitoring data remains challenging due to extreme class imbalance, heterogeneous clinical risk factors, multi-scale temporal dynamics, and substantial missingness. We propose NeoTriFuse, a reliability-aware multimodal fusion framework for missingness-heterogeneous neonatal monitoring data. Unlike conventional multimodal approaches that treat missingness primarily as a preprocessing issue, NeoTriFuse models missingness as an explicit reliability signal that dynamically modulates modality contributions during fusion. The framework integrates static perinatal variables, local-global temporal encoders, and patient-level statistical summaries through reliability-guided gating mechanisms, while jointly optimizing mortality prediction and an auxiliary length-of-stay objective. NeoTriFuse achieves competitive performance, with an F1 score of 0.6736 +/- 0.0216 and an AUROC of 0.9454 +/- 0.0056. Abl

translated_title: NeoTriFuse：面向新生儿死亡风险预测的缺失异质性下可靠性感知多模态融合
translated_abstract: 从床边监测数据预测新生儿死亡风险仍具挑战性，原因在于极端类别不平衡、临床风险因素异质性、多尺度时间动态以及大量数据缺失。我们提出NeoTriFuse，一种面向缺失异质性新生儿监测数据的可靠性感知多模态融合框架。与将缺失主要视为预处理问题的传统多模态方法不同，NeoTriFuse将缺失建模为明确的可靠性信号，在融合过程中动态调节模态贡献。该框架通过可靠性引导的门控机制整合静态围产期变量、局部-全局时间编码器以及患者级统计摘要，同时联合优化死亡预测和辅助住院时长目标。NeoTriFuse取得了竞争性性能，F1得分为0.6736 ± 0.0216，AUROC为0.9454 ± 0.0056。消融实验...
tldr: NeoTriFuse通过将数据缺失建模为可靠性信号并动态调节多模态融合贡献，结合静态变量、时间编码器和统计摘要，显著提升了新生儿死亡风险预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: NeoTriFuse models missingness as an explicit reliability signal to dynamically modulate multimodal fusion contributions, integrating static variables, temporal encoders, and statistical summaries, achieving robust neonatal mortality risk prediction.
